Spotlights
Transferable skills: key tools for education and work
From entrepreneurship to AI, from digital media to active citizenship, from communication and public engagement to employability: enroll now.
E-Cells Symposium 2026. From Research to Industry
On September 18, UniBo, Ferrari and NXP are organising a one-day event dedicated to research in battery cell technology, bringing together the academic community, industry and students.
The call for Great-ER is open!
Take part in the free, 12-month advanced incubation programme, designed to support the development of deep tech research-based business projects. Apply by 23 September.
Do you travel around Bologna and district?
You can purchase a subsidised annual pass for TPER buses until 15 December 2026, subject to the availability of funds.
Research the Future: PhD Open Day at UniBO
An online event for those who have completed, or are about to complete, their degree and want to understand whether a PhD is the right next step for their future: how it works and the career opportunities it offers today.

Become a candidate and represent PhD students on the Department Board
On 15 and 16 April 2026, by-elections will be held to elect student representatives for PhD students to the Department Board. You can submit your candidacy from 9 to 26 March 2026.

Premio Sclocchi
Cristian Cascioli, attualmente al primo anno di dottorato DIMSAI, laureato magistrale in Ingegneria Energetica, è risultato vincitore del “32esimo Premio Sclocchi” di SPE, Assorisorse ed EAGE per le migliori tesi del 2024 in ambito energetico, per la sua tesi magistrale dal titolo “Ottimizzazione del trattamento termico, caratterizzazione meccanica e microstrutturale di leghe alluminio-silicio da fonderia”, di cui è stata relatrice la Prof.ssa Lorella Ceschini e co-relatori il Prof. Alessandro Morri e l’Ing. Riccardo Arcaleni.
Financial Support for Healthcare Expenses for Non-Resident Students
The call for applications is open to students enrolled in PhD programs. Submit your application on Studenti Online by 30 April.

housing condition of students
What is the housing condition of students? Help us understand by filling out the questionnaire
Housing is a growing obstacle to education. The survey will help understand it, engage stakeholders, and push for concrete solutions.
Go to page
Can you turn your research into innovation?
Beyond Research is the free course dedicated to researchers at Unibo, aimed at enhancing results and fostering entrepreneurship. It grants university credits (CFU). Register by 25 September.
Go to page
Third edition of EU TalentOn
As part of the European project Science Comes to Town, the third edition of EU TalentOn is on the way. During this five-day scientific contest, a group of selected young researchers between the ages 21 and 35 years old from all over Europe will work in teams to come up with the best scientific solutions for challenges linked to one of the five EU Missions:
• Adaptation to Climate Change
• Cancer Prevention and Care
• Restore our Ocean and Water
• Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities
• A Soil Deal for Europe
The contest finale will take place between 7 and 11 September 2026 in Brest, France.
Travel, accommodation, and meals are fully covered during the finale week and a total of €80,000 of prize money will be divided into prizes over the 5 Mission Arenas, including a €12,000 Grand Jury prize.
The deadline for applying is April 30, 2026.
